headline: Spandana Sphoorty Financial updates exchange on credit rating
hook: Routine credit rating filing from Spandana
summary: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding a credit rating update. Retail investors should check subsequent filings for specific rating action details.
whats_next: Detailed credit rating report or subsequent exchange disclosure
